lines.text: The elder writes to the chosen lady and her children, wishing grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Jesus Christ.
The elder was overjoyed to find some of her children walking in the truth, and he urges that we love one another.
Many deceivers have gone into the world, refusing to confess the coming of Jesus Christ in the flesh, and they are antichrists.
Whoever remains in the teaching of Christ has both the Father and the Son, but he must not welcome a teacher without it.
The elder hopes to come and speak face to face instead of using paper and ink, so that their faith may be complete.
